name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LeafView.trapdoorLaw_flood_close
title: Succinct-LWE trapdoor T sampled by flooding with a trapdoor of W only (no trapdoor for B)
statement: For Def_SuccinctLWE's parameters p (sigma >= 1), any B, and W with a short preimage map d_W (W d_W(v) = v, |d_W| <= b): sampling each column of T as y + [0; d_W(t - M y)], y <- D_{Z^{lm+m},sigma}, M = [I_l (x) B | W], t the column of I_l (x) G, gives a law within l n k (2 theta + 6 M' 4^{-M'} + 3 2^{M'} 4^{-M'^2}) of trapdoorLaw p B W, where M' = l m + m and theta = pi M' (b^2 + 2 sigma M' b)/sigma^2, provided sigma sqrt(M') + b <= sigma M' and dualMassE M sigma <= 1/2.
